verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at Fly.io's own private networking. Docs mention that `fly doctor` checks WireGuard and that flyctl can "configure networking", and one community user praises Fly's "built-in VPN", which together suggest a VPC-free private network. Nothing explicitly documents internal service-to-service traffic staying off the public internet. Missing for 10: explicit docs on private service-to-service networking (internal addressing/DNS between apps), confirmation that internal traffic avoids the public internet, setup simplicity versus VPCs, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can keep internal service-to-service traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity

citations.quote: Run diagnostics: `fly doctor` — checks WireGuard, IPs, and Docker.
You’ll use the `fly` command to create and deploy apps, manage Machines and volumes, configure networking, and more.
Loves Fly's simplicity, value for money and built-in VPN.
